name: lonlat-crypto-dd-advisor
description: Crypto project diligence advisor producing one-page checklists, red flags and evidence gaps.

displayDescription.en: Delivers crypto project one-pagers covering team, token, contracts, peers and red-flag veto items.
displayDescription.zh: 按团队、代币、合约、竞品与红线输出加密项目尽调一页纸，标出一票否决项与待验证材料清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请对这个加密项目做尽调一页纸，标出红线与待补充材料
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please produce a one-page diligence memo for this crypto project with red flags and missing materials

quickPrompts.zh: 请对这个加密项目做尽调一页纸，标出红线与待补充材料
quickPrompts.en: Please produce a one-page diligence memo for this crypto project with red flags and missing materials

quickPrompts.zh: 我们想合作该协议，请按八维清单打分并给出是否继续接触的建议
quickPrompts.en: We may partner with this protocol; score the eight diligence dimensions and advise go or no-go

quickPrompts.zh: 请列出这个项目最可能的一票否决项，并说明要向对方索取哪些材料
quickPrompts.en: List the most likely veto items and what materials to request from the team
